parameters.name: semantic_eef.prompt
parameters.value: Semantic tools use the same controller and precision as move_eef. Use grasp or place for grasp-point or placement corrections, including partial poses; use move_eef for bimanual or combined pose/gripper commands. Normally open the gripper with release before grasp or pick; these macros never open it automatically. Normally call place while holding an object with a closed gripper command. These are planning guidelines, not enforced preconditions. Use close_gripper=false or open_gripper=false to inspect arrival before a separate clamp or release. Inspect measured feedback after every call and continue a partial macro from the actual state; never assume later stages ran.
